scope: Preserve absent versus explicit DXF $INSUNITS in the header writer and verify ASCII/binary raw output, public parseback, unchanged following geometry, and same-profile header replay.

localFinding.evidence: Before the fix, six focused assertions failed: AC1015 ASCII and binary output synthesized $INSUNITS=0 for an absent source variable, parseback observed it as present, and same-profile replay retained the synthesized presence. Explicit 0, 1, and 4 values passed. AC1014 legacy output remained absent.
localFinding.disposition: Fixed within the existing 7BJ.4 presence-policy owner; no new finding or subplan added.

implementation.policy: The DXF header writer emits $INSUNITS for AC1015+ only when the source DRW_Header contains an integer INSUNITS value; explicit zero remains explicit. $MEASUREMENT remains separately provided in the focused controls. No coordinate scaling or consumer behavior is changed.
generatedControls: AC1015 explicit INSUNITS 1 with crossed MEASUREMENT 0
AC1015 explicit INSUNITS 4 with crossed MEASUREMENT 0
following LINE coordinate sentinel and same-profile parse/write presence replay

limits: No native AutoCAD, FreeCAD, LibreCAD, or LibreCAD_3 insertion/import test ran.
No INSUNITSDEFSOURCE/INSUNITSDEFTARGET host-profile behavior was tested.
This does not define whether every producer's omitted INSUNITS is semantically equivalent to unitless zero.
No fixture, dependency, or CTest registration was added.
